change_list.title: Class booking: per-class seat cap
change_list.user_gain: Studios can cap each class at a set number of seats, so a class never overbooks.

from_the_user.who_has_it: Growth and Business plans, on the web and in the app
from_the_user.where_it_is_set: Classes, then a class, then Capacity
from_the_user.problem_heard: a popular class kept taking bookings after it filled, and someone was turned away at the door

change_list.title: Waitlist auto-fills cancelled class seats
change_list.user_gain: When someone cancels, the first person on the class waitlist gets the seat and a confirmation automatically.

change_list.title: SMS reminder send time editable per service
change_list.user_gain: Set a different reminder time for each service, such as 48 hours before a colour appointment and 2 hours before a haircut.

change_list.title: Partial deposit refunds
change_list.user_gain: Refund part of a deposit from the booking screen instead of all or nothing.

change_list.title: Fix duplicate reminder when appointment moved
change_list.user_gain: Clients who move an appointment get one reminder, not two.

change_list.title: Fix reminder not sent for bookings made after 11pm
change_list.user_gain: Bookings made after 11pm get their reminder like any other booking.

change_list.title: Fix Outlook sync dropping recurring events
change_list.user_gain: Recurring events stay in your calendar when you sync with Outlook.

change_list.title: Fix timezone label in internal admin log
Add end-to-end tests for class booking
Legacy webhook v1 triggers removed
change_list.what_to_do: Point each webhook at the v2 triggers (same names, marked v2) before the change ships.

change_list.title: Starter plan SMS reminders capped at 100 a month (was unlimited)
change_list.what_to_do: Nothing for most accounts; those sending more than 100 SMS a month can move to Growth or switch to email reminders.
